outcome: None of the trial laws promoted; physics, save schema and Worker runtime remain v0.37.0.
interpretation: Anisotropic face-normal rotational resistance is internally consistent with existing directional drag but not sufficiently movement-preserving at this absolute calibration (Broadwake −32.5%; 7/27 guard increases).

The geometric cross-section times lever strength has L^2 rather than L^4 uniform-size torque scaling, but the observed reference normalization cannot preserve travel diversity: one specimen suffers near extinction-level locomotion losses while others gain excessive movement and clamp dependence.
Changing a muscle reference from 14x7 px to the actual first Darter joint (35x21 parent, 35x14 child) repairs Darter's original regression without generalizing.
Physical coefficient/units, anisotropic fluid traction and biological tissue stress remain empirical assumptions; the paper by Karl Sims does not establish these coefficients.
Passing TypeScript/chemical-ledger/velocity-passivity tests is insufficient for deploying this candidate.
